ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a dominant low-intensity (black/dark-grey) base estimated at 75-80% and localized high-intensity (white) clusters occupying approximately 20-25% of the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Concentrated high-intensity white circular clusters on the left lobe (medial to lateral); a secondary large high-intensity cluster on the lower-medial right lobe; widespread high-intensity stippling concentrated in the central-lower fluke region where it meets the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression; interior angle of intersection approximately 42 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary on the left lobe trailing edge with high-frequency peaks (3-10 pixel amplitude); right lobe trailing edge is partially obscured by water spray but shows similar irregular topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The outer margin of the left lobe follows a convex parabolic curve; the right lobe trajectory is foreshortened due to orientation but exhibits a slight convexity before being obscured.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters arranged in 'rosette' patterns, primarily localized on the left-center lobe and the inner-right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal high-intensity linear disruption traversing the mid-left lobe; several smaller, faint horizontal linear scratches visible near the left-medial boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive focal white scarring consistent with barnacle attachment sites; one significant diagonal linear scar on the left lobe; irregular jagged tissue loss along the trailing edge boundaries.
other_distinctive_markers: A thin, high-intensity curvi-linear white 'filament' mark located in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe.
